theme_strategy.description: Clean, light-mode base for trustworthiness and clinical clarity. The platform shifts to a 'High-Alert Mode' (dark/red) exclusively during the active Emergency SOS workflow.

scale_rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-bold

brand.note: Avoid using teal (#1B93A4) as per forbidden rules. Use Sky and Slate to fulfill the 'soft blue/teal' user request without breaking dashboard rules.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-6 to p-12) for calm navigation, tight density (gap-4) only inside specific clinical data grids.

marketing_page.grid: Bento Grid Protocol - Mode A (Tetris Grid). Asymmetrical layout, wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12).

dashboards.grid: High Density Grid (Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4, gap-6.
dashboards.hierarchy: F-pattern. Place critical alerts/patient identity in top-left.

cards.style: Rounded cards (rounded-2xl) as per user request. 1px border (border-slate-200), minimal shadow (shadow-sm). No full-screen gradients.

customizations.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or generously rounded (rounded-xl) for primary actions. Distinct hover states.
customizations.inputs: Shadcn inputs with slightly larger padding (h-12) for accessibility and touch targets.
customizations.navigation: Mobile-first bottom nav for patient view (Home, Care, Emergency, Passport, Profile). Glassmorphic floating top nav for desktop.
customizations.cards: Do not overuse the Shadcn Card component default padding; customize it for density.
customizations.charts: Shadcn chart (recharts) for Medication adherence and Admin analytics. Must be color-blind friendly.

specific_features.sos_button: Always accessible. Floating or prominent in bottom nav. Uses pulsing micro-animation (animate-pulse).
specific_features.emergency_timeline: Animated state machine. Use Framer Motion to transition steps: SOS_ACTIVATED -> CAREGIVER_NOTIFIED -> RESPONDER_ASSIGNED -> AMBULANCE_EN_ROUTE -> HOSPITAL_NOTIFIED -> PATIENT_ARRIVED -> CASE_CLOSED.
specific_features.ocr_view: Split view (original image left vs. extracted data right). Highlight extracted fields.
specific_features.simulated_map: Responder dashboard requires a map visualization. Use a static dark map image or SVG grid background, overlaid with animated CSS/Framer Motion markers for Patient, Ambulance, and Hospital, showing an active route line.

motion_and_interactions.philosophy: Micro-interactions for feedback, delight, and urgency.
motion_and_interactions.medication_completion: Progress bar filling animation and a subtle bounce effect on the checkmark.
motion_and_interactions.emergency_pulse: Continuous dual-ring pulse around the active SOS button to draw attention.
motion_and_interactions.map_markers: Pulsing dots for live locations on the Responder dashboard.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All cards should slightly lift (-translate-y-1) and increase shadow on hover.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for floating elements (Top Nav, Voice Assistant button, Bottom Nav on mobile, Emergency SOS floating trigger) to maintain optical clarity on clinical data.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise/grain overlay on the marketing hero section to feel like a premium startup, not a sterile hospital.
visual_enhancers.data_visualization: Explainable AI insights must clearly separate 'Why?' (evidence) and 'Confidence' (score %).

accessibility.contrast: APCA contrast standards. Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='sos-activate-button', data-testid='medication-complete-checkbox').
accessibility.alerts: Never use color alone for alerts. Pair red/orange with warning icons (e.g., Lucide AlertTriangle).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a Hybrid Fullstack app: Start with a Marketing Landing Page, then build a Role-Switching login to access the 6 dashboards.
Ensure 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' fonts are imported from Google Fonts in index.html.
Do NOT use HTML <select> or <input type='date'>; strictly use Shadcn Select and Calendar components.
Create an Emergency State Context that wraps the application. When SOS is active, the UI must visually switch to indicate the emergency (e.g., red banners, dark mode toggle, flashing alerts).
Implement the 'Demo Control Center' to simulate the emergency state machine globally.
Do not add universal transitions (e.g., transition-all). Add transitions only to specific properties like background-color, transform.
Ensure mobile responsiveness with a Bottom Navigation bar for the Patient dashboard.
Do not use generic AI emojis; stick to Lucide icons.
